class.name: robot_arm_driver/ArmHardwareInterface
class.description: eMeetArm ros2_control hardware interface (CANopen / CiA402, SocketCAN). Drives J1-3 in interpolated-position (IP) mode via JointTrajectoryController, or profile-velocity (PV) mode via a velocity controller. Feedback is polled on a background thread and cached, so read() never blocks the control loop. Set sim_mode=true in the URDF hardware parameters to run without CAN (command echo) for dry-run / no-hardware debugging.
